g.title: Projection_Respect_Ego
g.text: Projection, Transference, Boundary Violation, Respect Collapse, Ego Display

g.title: Projection_Transference_Violation
g.text: Projection, Transference, and Boundary Violation — Diagrammatic Mapping

text.tspan: What can you bring to a persons retort, when they said: “it’s like dragging a corpse". Please give me a paragraph that provides an initial response
about a person who, to say such a phrase suggests an experience of the act itself, to think upon its implied discription and a second paragraph
that would be your considered response to such an implied act and phrase.
There feels a further responce that needs awareness and that is about 'respect' by offloading their possibility of experience into another's container,
the incredibility that a corpse should be denigrated in this way, might be construded as an appaling act.
To summerise the result, a loss of respect and standing feels an inevitability and his container failed to contain the experience,
could this be ego or a show of power and deliverence.
